Baltimore-Washington Financial Advisors Increased Alibaba Group Hldg LTD Adr (BABA) Stake by $1.08 Million; Stock Rose; Broadwood Capital Cut Its Stake in Delta Air Lines Del (Put) (DAL) as Share Price Rose
June 4, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Neal C. Bradsher decreased its stake in Delta Air Lines Inc Del (Put) (DAL) by 20% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Broadwood Capital Inc sold 50,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.16% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Neal C. Bradsher held 200,000 shares of the transportation company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $10.96M, down from 250,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Broadwood Capital Inc who had been investing in Delta Air Lines Inc Del (Put) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $38.66 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.65% or $0.9 during the last trading session, reaching $55.32. About 1.04M shares traded. Delta Air Lines, Inc. (NYSE:DAL) has risen 10.85% since June 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.72% the S&P500.
Baltimore-Washington Financial Advisors Inc increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd Adr (BABA) by 12.78% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Baltimore-Washington Financial Advisors Inc bought 5,881 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.58% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 51,906 shares of the business services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $9.53 million, up from 46,025 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Baltimore-Washington Financial Advisors Inc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd Adr for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $533.26B market cap company. The stock increased 1.56% or $3.2 during the last trading session, reaching $207.54. About 7.27M shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 61.13% since June 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 48.56% the S&P500.
